title: General.
officialText:
Ceramic kilns with a maximum interior volume of 20 cubic feet (0.566 m3) and used for hobby and noncommercial
purposes shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions and the provisions of this code.
SECTION FGC 630
INFRARED RADIANT HEATERS
